compatibility_data: Nonzero participation limits and nns_proposal_id=0 are required constructor compatibility data, not an offer, accepted contribution or NNS creation proposal.
clock_invariant: Pinned Swap converts a u64 nanosecond clock to seconds; u64::MAX seconds is unreachable.
unexpected_balance_policy: Zero genesis allocations are distinct from later transfers. Record observed default-Account balances without asserting all Swap subaccounts are empty. Unsolicited ICP is quarantined, never backing, permanent capital or funding; it does not block acceptance. Later IO remains claim-bearing under canonical total-supply/reserve/exclusion accounting, including actual fee burns.
upgrade_policy: Only the default blessed SNS-W path is demonstrated unregistered. Review every Swap successor for preservation of the parked invariant; no unpublished successor is assumed.
native_treasury_restriction: Zero Swap price prevents source-defined native SNS-token valuation; do not fabricate price or proceeds.
